messages:
anya: Quick check  proposing a compact button variant for dense tables. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-variant. Issue: visual 28px feels tight and focus ring clips inside the card. Opinions?

mike: avoid fixed heights. keep visual 28px but add invisible hit padding to meet 44px touch target. wrapper works well.

lee: focus clip is from .card { overflow: hidden }. either move actions to an overflow-visible slot or use outline-offset token. moving slot preferred to preserve shadows.

harper: also add tokens for toast durations and focus offset. suggest toast.medium=2400ms and focus.outlineOffset=3px. toasts should be aria-live=polite and rendered in a portal outside modals.

anya: thanks  i'll update Figma, add hit-wrapper pattern, remove svg translate hacks, center icons with inline-flex, add tokens and open a small PR today. design-bot: can you create the tokens?

design-bot: created tokens: spacing.compact=6px, touch.hitPadding=8px, toast.duration.medium=2400ms, focus.outlineOffset=3px. PR: #901.
